dimensions.name: total_prescriptions_num
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN source.total_prescriptions LIKE '% M' THEN CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(source.total_prescriptions, 1, LENGTH(source.total_prescriptions) - 2)) AS DECIMAL(28,2)) * 1000000
  WHEN source.total_prescriptions LIKE '% K' THEN CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(source.total_prescriptions, 1, LENGTH(source.total_prescriptions) - 2)) AS DECIMAL(28,2)) * 1000
  WHEN source.total_prescriptions LIKE '% B' THEN CAST(TRIM(SUBSTRING(source.total_prescriptions, 1, LENGTH(source.total_prescriptions) - 2)) AS DECIMAL(28,2)) * 1000000000
  ELSE TRY_CAST(source.total_prescriptions AS DECIMAL(28,2))
END

datasets.name: drug_therapeutic_mapping
queryLines:
SELECT
  drug_name_base,
  CASE
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'BIKTARVY' THEN 'HIV Treatment'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'DUPIXENT' THEN 'Eczema, Asthma, Chronic Rhinosinusitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'HUMIRA' THEN 'Rheumatoid Arthritis, Crohn''s Disease, Psoriasis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'OZEMPIC' THEN 'Type 2 Diabetes'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'INVEGA SUSTENNA' THEN 'Schizophrenia, Schizoaffective Disorder'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'SKYRIZI' THEN 'Plaque Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis, Crohn''s Disease'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'DESCOVY' THEN 'HIV Treatment and PrEP'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'ENBREL' THEN 'Rheumatoid Arthritis, Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'KISQALI' THEN 'Breast Cancer'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'COSENTYX UNOREADY' THEN 'Psoriatic Arthritis, Ankylosing Spondylitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'COSENTYX' THEN 'Psoriatic Arthritis, Ankylosing Spondylitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'COSENTYX SENSOREADY' THEN 'Psoriatic Arthritis, Ankylosing Spondylitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'ELIQUIS' THEN 'Blood Clot Prevention, Atrial Fibrillation'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'GENOTROPIN' THEN 'Growth Hormone Deficiency'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'VRAYLAR' THEN 'Schizophrenia, Bipolar Disorder'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'JARDIANCE' THEN 'Type 2 Diabetes, Heart Failure'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'NURTEC ODT' THEN 'Migraine Treatment and Prevention'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'STELARA' THEN 'Plaque Psoriasis, Crohn''s Disease, Ulcerative Colitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'SUBOXONE' THEN 'Opioid Use Disorder'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'INVEGA HAFYERA' THEN 'Schizophrenia'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'INVEGA TRINZA' THEN 'Schizophrenia'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'KESIMPTA' THEN 'Multiple Sclerosis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'TREMFYA' THEN 'Plaque Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis'
    WHEN
      drug_name_base = 'SIMPONI'
    THEN
      'Rheumatoid Arthritis, Psoriatic Arthritis, Ulcerative Colitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'UZEDY ER' THEN 'Schizophrenia'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'AVONEX' THEN 'Multiple Sclerosis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'AVONEX PEN' THEN 'Multiple Sclerosis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'BIMZELX' THEN 'Plaque Psoriasis'
    WHEN
      drug_name_base = 'TALTZ'
    THEN
      'Plaque Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis, Ankylosing Spondylitis'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'SANDOSTATIN LAR DEPOT' THEN 'Acromegaly, Carcinoid Syndrome'
    WHEN drug_name_base = 'LUPRON DEPOT' THEN 'Prostate Cancer, Endometriosis, Fibroids'
    WHEN
      drug_name_base = 'CIMZIA'
    THEN
      'Rheumatoid Arthritis, Crohn''s Disease, Psoriatic Arthritis'
    ELSE 'Other Therapeutic Use'
  END as therapeutic_use
FROM
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      TRIM(REGEXP_EXTRACT(drug_name, '^([A-Za-z\\s]+)', 1)) as drug_name_base
    FROM
      pbm.nadac_pipeline.gold_top_drugs_by_spending
